product.title: the B6 integration of the shared files

pending.claim: _credit prints 'cycle date not recorded' or 'date not recorded' when the index has no as_of. The About's FAA and PAD-US credit lines use it (build.py:1681). D130(b) says such a date prints 'Data unavailable', never 'date not recorded'. No test pins the wording, so the change is free.
pending.fix: Print 'Data unavailable' for a missing date at lines 1199 and 1201; add a test with as_of None that checks the About credit line.

pending.claim: When the heat picture is unavailable, the fallback 'the five seasons in the store' completes 'Days at or above 90 F are counted over ...', so the page reads as a count with no missing-value wording. Rule 5 needs Data unavailable here.
pending.evidence: about.html:94 uses {{ b6.heat_window or 'the five seasons in the store' }}; b6.heat_window is None when the heat90 picture window is absent (build.py:1679).
pending.fix: Fall back to 'Data unavailable in this update. This is not an all-clear.', the same sentence the relief and land cover lines use.

pending.claim: Rulings made after the integrators reported are not yet in the worktree. D128(a): labels.py:398 still passes P4's label_legend (history_layers.py:194); build.py:1395 overrides it for the page, but the module text remains. D128(e): no landmark mirror, so hail/index.json base holds only format, terrain and vector (landmarks.py writes none). D128(f): no --refresh-descriptions flag (see B6-R1). pending.claim: Five printed vector sentences do not carry 'Data unavailable' (AGENTS rule 5), and the build's safety net does not reach them.
pending.evidence: Built data/base.json base.vector.words holds unavailable, part_unavailable, partial_named, peaks_unknown and band_d_water_partial without the words (basemap2.py lines 308, 310, 312, 314, 328). build.py _rule5 (line 1619, used by _rule5_blocks at line 1626) adds the lead only to block 'problem' strings, not to 'words' entries. AGENTS rule 5 and D117(b) require the words; D128(b) orders the module fix for the post-integration round.
pending.fix: In the product round (D128(b)) add 'Data unavailable.' to those five WORDS entries. Also widen the rule-5 pass to the words that can be printed, or add a test that every unavailable or partial sentence in data/base.json contains 'Data unavailable'.

pending.claim: Hospital and zone-outline credits are static or unconditional, and a missing credit date would print 'date not recorded', against D130(b).
pending.evidence: about.html:79-81 names only the USGS hospital list and says a copy 'carries its own credit' without printing it; the HIFLD copy's line (landmarks.py:196) is never printed. about.html:103 prints the outline credit, and build.py:1527 always sets it, even when the outline block is unavailable. landmarks._credit (landmarks.py:1194-1202) prints 'date not recorded' or 'cycle date not recorded' when as_of is missing, and build.py:1661-1663 passes the index's date to it. D130(b) asks for 'Data unavailable'. The current store has the dates and the USGS layer answers, so these cases are latent.
pending.fix: Choose the hospital credit from the block's hospital source (USGS or the HIFLD copy), print the outline credit only when the outline state is loaded or partial, and print 'Data unavailable' for a missing date. Add tests for the HIFLD and missing-outline cases.

pending.claim: The published index states a use conclusion for a held source that counsel has not reached.
pending.evidence: landmarks.py:237 gives the tiger_park terms 'Not copyrighted; free to use in a product or publication.' The built copy publishes it in hail/base/index.json (sources.tiger_park.terms). The same source is held because 'the file's use constraints are for counsel to read' (landmarks.py:140), and counsel item 21 is open (D115, D129(a)). The copy is served with the site.
pending.fix: Replace the terms text with the hold (for example 'use constraints not yet read; held for counsel'), or leave the terms out of the copied index for held sources.

pending.claim: Two different PAD-US credit lines appear on the same page.
pending.evidence: Line 61 credits 'Protected Areas Database of the United States (PAD-US) 4.1, U.S. Geological Survey (parks)' (basemap2 CREDIT). Line 85 (b6.padus_credit) credits 'USGS Gap Analysis Project, Protected Areas Database ... local parks'. D115(d) asks for one complete credit line per source.
pending.fix: Keep one PAD-US credit line, naming the party the terms ask for, and use it in both places.
